meta.description: Writer-level timing parameters of the KLiCKe TRAIN split for timing_model='klicke_ar1'.
meta.scope: KLiCKe is argumentative texts by adult writers in the United States (L1 and L2) typed in a web-based keystroke logger, not scholarly LaTeX.
meta.split: TRAIN = even index of the id-sorted eligible writers (measure_gap.split_writers); no writer ids and no held-out values are stored

columns.mu, sigma: mean and sd (ddof=1) of log IKI over the non-pause IKIs (<= pause_threshold_ms)
columns.rho: lag-1 Pearson autocorrelation of log IKI over the non-pause sequence (pauses removed, order kept)
columns.p_pause: share of valid IKIs above pause_threshold_ms
columns.pause_mu, pause_sigma: parameters of the normal on log IKI before truncation to [pause_threshold_ms, iki_filter_ms[1]); doubly truncated normal MLE of the observed pauses
columns.pause_log_mean, pause_log_sd: observed mean and sd (ddof=1) of log pauses (reference only)
columns.n_windows: valid IKIs // window; the simulator draws a row with probability proportional to it
